description: Should I send my Base transaction now or wait? Returns send_now or wait, the reason, the USD cost now and ready-to-sign EIP-1559 fees. Use before sending any transaction on Base. Costs about $0.003. Each call makes a real USDC micropayment on Base mainnet via x402 from BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY; payments above MAX_USD_PER_CALL are refused. Do not call it in loops.

gasLimit.description: Gas units to price. 21000 ETH transfer (default), ~65000 ERC-20 transfer, ~85000 NFT mint, ~180000 Uniswap swap, ~1500000 contract deploy.
